description: Update fields of an existing event on a Google Calendar calendar.

calendar_id.description: The ID of the calendar to update the event on. Defaults to "primary" if omitted.

description.description: The new description of the event.

end.description: The new end time of the event, as an RFC 3339 date-time string.

event_id.description: The ID of the event to update.

location.description: The new location of the event.

start.description: The new start time of the event, as an RFC 3339 date-time string.

summary.description: The new title (summary) of the event.

name: update_event
